action.content: Write an academic proposal to a customer who's interested in implementing a new feature for their product. Put double quotes around your entire response.
action.label: context

action.content:
"Dear Customer,

I am writing to propose the implementation of a new feature for your product. This feature is designed to enhance user experience and streamline your workflow, making it a valuable addition to your current offerings.

The proposed feature will be user-friendly and intuitive, requiring minimal training for your team. It will also be fully compatible with your existing infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration without any disruption to your current operations.

We believe that this feature will provide significant benefits to your customers, leading to increased satisfaction and loyalty. Additionally, it aligns with our company's vision for continuous improvement and innovation.

I would like to schedule a meeting to discuss this proposal in more detail. Please let me know your availability, and I will do my best to accommodate your schedule.

Thank you for considering this proposal. I look forward to the opportunity to work together and bring this feature to life.

Best regards,

[Your Name]"
action.label: response
